### Fixed
- **`call_tool` no longer loses images, audio, embedded resources, resource links, content annotations or result `_meta` of the tool it wraps.** The envelope JSON keeps image and audio items size-only (`{type, mimeType, dataSize}`) so it stays small for a model reading it, and the items follow the envelope as native MCP content with their payload, in order. Content `annotations` and `_meta` are kept on every envelope item and the result's `_meta` is a new `_meta` envelope field. The agent client restores every content type from the envelope, the image and audio payloads from the native items, and the result `_meta`; `muster call` renders the first text item instead of failing when a result starts with an image. A result that uses none of these keeps its envelope byte for byte.
